Your safety is very important to us, so you can conveniently control the app with the controls for the radio. We wish you a pleasant and safe journey with your Volkswagen up!

Configuration wizard:

1. Download the maps + more app from the App Store
2. Pair your smartphone with your vehicle via Bluetooth.
3. Open the maps + more app
4. Accept the terms of use.
5. maps + more will try to connect to your vehicle. A code will be displayed in the app and on your infotainment system. Confirm this code to continue.
6. maps + more is now connected to your vehicle and ready to use.
7. The navigation function is now activated and you may leave your vehicle.
8. A map is required for the navigation function. You can now download this map by selecting the "Navigation" function in the app. We recommend downloading the map via a WLAN connection.
9. Download the map and activate it.
10. Read and accept the safety instructions for using the navigation function.
11. To keep the navigation function active, you must connect maps + more to your vehicle at least once every four weeks.

*maps + more is only compatible with the Composition Phone radio in up!.
